releaseNotes:
1. Default Camera: App launch defaults to Mayiladuthurai (11.1075, 79.6524, zoom 13.0).
2. Marker Rename Ergonomics: Autofocus, cursor at text end, and post-rename map recentering.
3. Non-Overlapping Marker Labels: Shifted top-right (Offset(16,-10)) with 40% white fill and 50% border stroke, eliminating line crossover.
4. Collapsible Floating Toolbar: 35% opacity vertical toolbar with 3-dots/arrow toggle, auto-collapsing on selection or map tap.
5. Bottom-Right Controls: Location and Zoom buttons moved to bottom-right with 30% background opacity.
6. Compact Map Scale: Reduced dimensions with 60% opacity black chip.
7. Top-Left Compass: Real-time map bearing rotation and smooth one-tap reset to North.
